name: showreel-c3-stop-centring

voice.text: Stop centring everything. It looks neat. Turns out, it's hard to read. Watch your eye. Every centred line starts somewhere new, so it jumps. Line them up on the left. It reads in one smooth path.

caption:
Stop centring everything. It looks neat, but it's hard to read. 📄

Every centred line starts somewhere new, so your eye has to jump to find it.

1. Line the text up on the left.
2. Keep centring for one short title.
3. Let the right edge be ragged.

Save this for your next poster, menu or slide. Team centre or team left?

sources.title: F-Shaped Pattern of Reading on the Web (Nielsen Norman Group)

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (the brick wall) fills the frame by design
